kind.value: Hosted open-source scheduler (AGPL-3.0), run by Nasida Apps LLC

hosting.value: Hosted only; the modified source is published under AGPL-3.0

pricingModel.value: Flat monthly plans, tiered by number of channels

freeOption.value: A 7-day free trial with no card, then paid plans

api.value: Public REST API and webhooks on every plan

mcp.value: MCP server on every plan, with sign-in (OAuth) or an API key

ai.value: Bring your own: AI runs on your own OpenAI key or the assistant you connect over MCP; PostDelegate never charges for AI

teams.value: Team members on Team, Pro and Ultimate; client approval links that need no account
